summary: Provision break-glass, time-bound audit access for KMS rotation evidence collection (Security/GRC)
description:
Request type: Break-glass audit access (time-bound)

Requester: Daniel Carter (Security & Compliance / Evidence)
Business justification:
- Need to collect/verify rotation evidence for upcoming audits and customer security reviews.
- Evidence requires exporting and validating rotation-related audit events (key version updates, cutover toggles), plus confirming the exporter schema includes new KMS rotation event types.

Scope of access requested (read-only):
1) Audit log export admin console (read-only) to run/export queries for a defined window.
2) Production audit-log-exporter job logs (read-only) for validation/troubleshooting.
3) Control-plane audit events index/search (read-only) for rotation event verification.

Out of scope / explicitly NOT requested:
- No ability to modify KMS keys, key policies, or rotation flags.
- No write permissions to audit event streams or exporter configuration.
- No access to customer payload data; audit metadata only.

Requested duration:
- Start: 2025-11-05 09:00 PT
- End (automatic expiry): 2025-11-12 17:00 PT

Controls requested:
- Separate break-glass role from normal day-to-day roles.
- MFA required; session timeouts enforced.
- Access should be logged (who/when/what) for evidence.

Approvals:
- Marcus Lin (Security Eng Director) approval required
- Dr. Aisha Rahman (Security exec sponsor) approval required
- Olivia/Compliance sign-off: Olga Petrov to confirm evidence requirements coverage

References:
- CISO mailbox thread: 20251104-rotation-evidence-template-and-approvals
- Customer evidence request context: SUP-19405 (enterprise customer asking for rotation procedure + evidence)

Acceptance criteria:
- Break-glass role created and assigned to Daniel Carter (and only Daniel Carter) with read-only scopes above.
- Role expires automatically on 2025-11-12 17:00 PT.
- Confirmation comment includes exact role name, granted permissions, and expiry.
- Audit trail of role activation is captured and linkable for evidence.

resolution: Created and granted time-bound, read-only break-glass audit role (breakglass-audit-evidence-readonly) to Daniel Carter for KMS rotation evidence gathering. MFA/session controls enforced; access automatically expired on 2025-11-12 17:00 PT and was removed/verified.
